case: the file is absent (built in the spec: nothing is written)
sentence: committed-content-missing: no content is kept under the hash 0123456789abcdef

case: a directory stands where the file belongs (built in the spec; {systemError} is the OS message)
sentence: committed-content-missing: it could not be read ({systemError})

case: the bytes are not UTF-8 text (built in the spec)
sentence: committed-content-missing: it is not UTF-8 text
committed-content-missing: it is not valid JSON ({parserError})
committed-content-missing: it is not an object of a text "title" and a text "body"

case: the title and body do not hash to the file name
sentence: committed-content-missing: its title and body do not hash to 0123456789abcdef
